Sure! Here’s a simple yet flavorful way to make an **Indian‑style grilled steak** with a quick tandoori‑inspired rub. It’s easy enough for a weeknight dinner but still feels special. --- ## Quick Tandoori‑Style Steak Recipe | Step | What to Do | Tips | |------|------------|------| | **1. Choose the cut** | Use a tender cut like ribeye, sirloin, or strip steak (about 1–1.5 cm thick). | Thinner cuts cook faster; thicker ones stay juicier. | | **2. Make the rub** | In a bowl mix:
• 1 Tbsp ground cumin
• 1 Tbsp ground coriander
• 1 Tbsp smoked paprika (or regular paprika)
• ½ Tbsp garam masala
• ½ tsp turmeric
• ½ tsp cayenne pepper (adjust for heat)
• 1 tsp salt
• 1 tsp black pepper | If you have fresh ginger & garlic, add 1 tsp each minced. | | **3. Marinate the steak** | Pat the steak dry. Rub both sides generously with the spice mix. Let it sit at room temp for 15 min, then refrigerate for at least 30 min (up to 24 h if you’re planning ahead). | A short marination gives a nice crust; longer adds depth. | | **4. Preheat your grill or skillet** | Heat a cast‑iron pan or grill over high heat until smoking hot. | A very hot surface creates a good sear. | | **5. Cook the steak** | Place steak on the grill/pan. Sear 2–3 min per side for medium‑rare (adjust time for thickness). Flip only once. | Avoid pressing down; let juices redistribute. | | **6. Finish with butter & herbs** | While resting, melt 1 Tbsp butter with 1 tsp chopped fresh cilantro or parsley. Drizzle over the steak. | Adds richness and a fresh finish. | | **7. Rest & serve** | Let the steak rest 5 min before slicing against the grain. Serve with a squeeze of lime and a side of mint yogurt sauce or a simple cucumber raita. | Resting locks in juices. | ### Optional: Quick Yogurt Marinade (for extra tenderness) If you have time, replace step 3 with a yogurt‑based marination: | Ingredient | Amount | |-------------|--------| | Plain Greek yogurt | ¼ cup | | Lemon juice | 1 Tbsp | | Ground cumin | 1 tsp | | Ground coriander | 1 tsp | | Garam masala | ½ tsp | | Salt | ½ tsp | | Fresh minced garlic & ginger | 1 tsp each | Mix all together, coat the steak, and refrigerate 2–4 h (or overnight). Then follow steps 4–7. --- #### Serving Ideas | Side | Why it works | |------|--------------| | **Mint‑y cucumber raita** | Cool, creamy contrast to the spicy steak. | | **Roasted cauliflower “rice”** | Low‑carb alternative that absorbs flavors. | | **Grilled naan or flatbread** | Perfect for scooping up juices. | | **Sautéed spinach with garlic** | Adds greens and balances richness. | Enjoy your homemade Indian‑style steak!
